duas.english_text: Ibn Umar (ra) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to repeat in a single sitting: My Lord, forgive me, and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.
duas.transliteration: Rabbigh'fir lī wa tub `alayy innaka antat-Tawwābu 'l-Ghafūr
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
duas.narration: Ibn Umar (ra) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to repeat in a single sitting:
duas.note: He would repeat this supplication 100 times in a single sitting before standing up.
duas.reference: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/321. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.
